resources.string:
AstroClock measures time by astronomical standards.

The shortest hand shows the position of the sun during a day. Unlike an normal hour hand, this hand turns only once in 24 hours.
Smaller hands show the moments of sunrise and sunset.

The middle hand shows the phase of the moon. It turns every 29.5 days

The longest hand shows the position of the earth in its orbit around the sun. It turns every 365.25 days

Like a normal clock, the hands rotate in clockwise direction.

The alarms section shows the moments of upcoming day / moon / year events. Select the checkboxes for recurring audible notifications.
For instructions on creating your own theme please visit android.arnodenhond.com/apps/astroclock/skins
Disclaimer\nThis app does not spy or otherwise misbehave in any way. Some screens are known to show after-images when displaying the same graphics over a long period.

About me\nThis app has been under semi-continuous development on evenings and weekends since April 2009 by Arno den Hond from Amsterdam (The Netherlands) on a MacBook Pro and has been tested on a Motorola Droid, Samsung Galaxy Tab, Asus Transformer and a LG Optimus
Credits\nMany thanks to the graphics artists whose names are listed in the themes screen and to Kostas of kanguro.fi for inspiring me on the promo text

Advertsing Keywords\nTo develop this app I had to spend money on the equipment mentioned above so to recover that money I have added advertising to the top of this screen.\nTo reduce the annoyance of this advertising you can enter some of your favorite topic below and the advertising might become more interesting.
Support AstroClock\nIf you like AstroClock, please let somebody know by pressing any of the buttons below. Thanks!
Share this app to a social network

Sunrise Alarm\nIf you really like AstroClock or if you want to wake up each day at sunrise but the beep doesn\'t wake you up, then please consider downloading Sunrise alarm. It\'s not free but by paying you would show your appreciation for AstroClock and support further development of this and other apps. Thank you!

Day vs. Night\nTo express my gratitude to you for downloading this app and because I didnt know a better place to put this, here is a progressbar showing the length of today\'s day vs. the length of today\'s night.
